bay.sub: Drag, tap, arrow keys, or the buttons under the screen. Leaving the page or the tab pauses the run.

comboLegend.title: Combo colour
comboLegend.note: The number in the HUD is the combo. It is wiped after 4 placements in a row with no clear, and every miss drains the colour one step:
comboLegend.off: No combo, or the streak was broken
comboLegend.miss3: 3rd miss - one more and the combo is gone

blockblast.desc: An 8x8 board and three pieces at a time: drag them in, fill a row or a column to clear it. No timer - you lose only when nothing fits.

flag.easyTip: --easy-mode: more long bars and big squares

blockblast.flagEasy: Gentle pieces: only straight lines and squares (no corners) - and the long bars and big squares show up far more often, so filling a line and chaining combos is much easier.
blockblast.flagRollback: Adds the Undo button (key U, pad undo) that takes back the last placement, score included.
blockblast.flagsTitle: Command-line flags - click a switch below, same as adding it to play blockblast.

keys.drag: drag a piece from the tray

blockblast.title: Block Blast

games.heading: Games
games.subtitle: Small games that run right in the page. No download, no plugin - and the terminal can start them too.

tetris.desc: Seven shapes, ten columns, and a level curve that speeds up every ten lines. Ghost piece and hold included.
tetris.flagEasy: No speed-up: the level stays at 1 and the fall interval is a constant 800ms.
tetris.flagRollback: Adds the Undo button (key U, pad undo) that takes back the last piece.
tetris.flagsTitle: Command-line flags - click a switch below, same as adding it to play tetris.
tetris.title: Tetris
